messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T is $799, about 840 W — roughly $60 a month in power at 10¢, and Batch 5 ships November 14, 2026.
Looked up for Sarah: The 40T is our best value per TH — one unit draws for a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, and you keep the machine.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Magic Miner 40T at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T runs 650 W at 40 TH — about $47 a month at ten cents — and ~50 dB in Eco, desk-sized at 33 by 16.5 by 19 cm.
A great first miner. The Magic Miner 40T is seven ninety-nine, the best value per terahash we sell. Are you after the block shot, or stacking sats?

At eight-forty watts, the 40T runs about sixty dollars a month in power at your rate. That puts out as much heat as a space heater. Will it be right next to you? (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
